stdout:
SeatTrellis CLI — standalone solve + export tool.

USAGE:
    seattrellis_cli <COMMAND> [OPTIONS]
    seattrellis_cli --version

COMMANDS:
    doctor       Check the environment (binary/version/temp dir).
    validate Check a solve-request JSON without running the search.
    precheck  Report candidate seat domains and infeasibility reasons.
    audit     Audit a solved plan: hard-rule status + soft breakdown.
    candidates  Generate a diverse candidate set.
    history-report  Summarize historical seating snapshots.
    pair-report     Summarize historical desk-mate / neighbor pairs.
    repair    Re-solve a snapshot while preserving anchors.
    edit       Apply manual edit operations to a snapshot or candidate set.
    score      Score a fixed assignment with the PlanScore breakdown.
    project-init  Create a project workspace file.
    project-list   List recent projects under a root.
    project-info  Show a project workspace summary.
    project-validate Validate a project and its files.
    project-solve   Solve a project workspace.
    project-export  Export a project plan.
    project-rotate  Generate future seating periods for a project.
    project-edit    Apply manual edits to a project seating artifact.
    project-repair  Re-solve a project artifact preserving anchors.
    project-privacy Scan a project for sensitive fields.
    project-pack    Back up a project as a .seattrellis.zip bundle.
    project-restore Restore a project bundle.
    schema-list    List the v2 artifact registry.
    schema-export   Write the JSON Schema for one artifact kind.
    schema-migrate  Validate and rewrite a versioned JSON artifact.
    solve    Solve a seating problem and print a summary of the result.
    export   Render a solved seating plan as SVG, HTML, PNG, PDF, XLSX, DOCX,
    or PPTX.
    help     Show this help.

DOCTOR:
    seattrellis_cli doctor

      Prints the binary name, version, core API version and a
      temp-dir writability probe (fails with exit 2 when not writable).

EDIT:
    seattrellis_cli edit --snapshot <snapshot.json> --operation <op>... [--candidate <id>]
             [--operations-file <file>] [--output <file>] [--strict]

      --snapshot <file>  Snapshot or candidate-set JSON. Required.
      --candidate <id>   Candidate ID for a candidate set (default: recommended).
      --operation <op>    String operation, repeatable and ordered. Examples: swap:STU001:STU002,
             move:STU003:R2C2, batch-move:STU001=R1C2,STU002=R1C1, unseat:STU004,
             lock-seat:R1C1, lock-student:STU001, unlock-seat:R1C1.
      --operations-file <file> JSON operation log applied before --operation values.
      --strict       Fail instead of writing when hard constraints are violated.

VALIDATE:
    seattrellis_cli validate --problem <problem.json> [--preset <name>] [--history <snapshot.json>]...
             [--history-dir <dir>] [--strict]

      --problem <file>  Solve-request JSON (CoreSolveRequest). Required.
      --preset <name>  Preset name for preset-context warnings.
      --history <file>  History snapshot counted for preset history warnings.
      --history-dir <dir>  Directory scanned for *.snapshot.json files (joins --history).
      --strict       Treat warnings as validation failures.

PRECHECK:
    seattrellis_cli precheck --problem <problem.json>

      --problem <file>  Solve-request JSON (CoreSolveRequest). Required.

AUDIT:
    seattrellis_cli audit --problem <problem.json> --solution <result.json>

      --problem <file>   The solve-request JSON used for solve. Required.
      --solution <file>  The solve result JSON (CoreSolveResponse). Required.

SCORE:
    seattrellis_cli score --problem <problem.json> --assignment <json> [--latest-snapshot <file>] [--diversity <f>]

      --problem <file>    Solve-request JSON (CoreSolveRequest). Required.
      --assignment <json>  Inline [[student, seat], ...] index pairs. Required.
      --latest-snapshot <file>  Optional snapshot for the stability dimension.
      --diversity <f>       Optional diversity score for the diversity dimension.

CANDIDATES:
    seattrellis_cli candidates --problem <problem.json> [--count <n>]

      --problem <file>  Solve-request JSON (CoreSolveRequest). Required.
      --count <n>        Candidate set size (1-20, default 5).

HISTORY-REPORT:
    seattrellis_cli history-report --problem <problem.json> [--history <snapshot.json>]... [--history-dir <dir>] [--output <file>]

      --problem <file>   Solve-request JSON providing students + layout. Required.
      --history <file>  Snapshot JSON (repeatable).
      --history-dir <dir>  Directory scanned for *.snapshot.json files.
      --output <file>   Also write the JSON report to a file.

PAIR-REPORT:
    seattrellis_cli pair-report --problem <problem.json> [--history <snapshot.json>]... [--history-dir <dir>]
                           [--top <n>] [--within-distance <n>]

      --problem <file>   Solve-request JSON providing students + layout. Required.
      --history <file>  Snapshot JSON (repeatable).
      --history-dir <dir>  Directory scanned for *.snapshot.json files.
      --top <n>        High-frequency pairs to display (default 10).
      --within-distance <n>  Chebyshev distance threshold (default 2).

REPAIR:
    seattrellis_cli repair --problem <problem.json> --snapshot <snapshot.json>
              [--lock-student <key>]... [--lock-seat <seat>]... [--affected <key>]...
              [--ignore-saved-locks] [--output <file>]

      --problem <file>    Solve-request JSON (students/layout/rules). Required.
      --snapshot <file>  Current snapshot JSON (assignments). Required.
      --lock-student <key>   Student that keeps its current seat (repeatable).
      --lock-seat <seat>    Seat whose occupant keeps it (repeatable).
      --affected <key>    Bounds the re-solve scope (repeatable).
      --ignore-saved-locks  Do not reuse locks persisted in the snapshot metadata.
      --output <file>   Write the repaired snapshot (default: stdout).

PROJECT:
    seattrellis_cli project-info|project-validate|project-solve|project-export --project <project.json>
      --project <file>  Portable project workspace file. Required.
      --seed <n>        Override the project's solver seed.
      --strict       project-validate only: treat warnings as failures.
      --candidates <n>    project-solve only: candidate count 1-20 (default: the
              project's default_candidates).
      --report <file>  project-solve only: also write a plan comparison report.
      --format <f>       project-export only: svg|html|print-html|png|pdf|xlsx|docx|pptx
              (default: the project's default_export_format).
      --template <t>    project-export only: teacher (default; real names, ids and
              detail fields) or public (anonymized wall copy: no names,
              no student ids, no height/vision).
      --orientation <o> project-export only: portrait|landscape|auto
              (default auto: print-html prints landscape A4, other
              formats portrait).
      --candidate <id>   project-export only: candidate ID for a candidate-set
              snapshot (default: recommended).
      --output <file>   project-solve/export write their artifact here.
      --snapshot <file>  project-export only: the saved plan to render (the
              result of 'project-solve --output <snapshot.json>'). Exporting
              never re-solves; it renders exactly the saved plan.

SOLVE:
    seattrellis_cli solve --problem <problem.json> [--seed <n>] [--time-limit <sec>] [--output <result.json>]

      --problem <file>  Solve-request JSON (CoreSolveRequest). Required.
      --seed <n>        Override the problem's solver seed.
      --time-limit <sec>   Wall-clock budget; exhausted searches report Timeout.
      --output <file>   Also write the full result JSON (CoreSolveResponse) to <file>.

EXPORT:
    seattrellis_cli export --problem <problem.json> --solution <result.json> \
                           --format <svg|html|png|pdf|xlsx|docx|pptx> --output <file>

      --problem <file>   The same solve-request JSON used for solve (seat grid). Required.
      --solution <file>  The solve result JSON (CoreSolveResponse). Required.
      --format <f>       Output format: svg, html, png, pdf, xlsx, docx, or pptx. Required.
      --output <file>    Write the rendered plan to <file>. Required.

EXIT STATUS:
    0 on success; 2 on invalid input/arguments; 3 infeasible; 4 timeout;
    5 unknown; 70 internal error; 130 cancelled (frozen v2 table, plan M1-03).
